description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

You will join the Predictive Intelligence engineering team within Anaplan, the group responsible for the Syrup platform and the family of forecasting and predictive services that power Anaplan’s verticalized solutions. The team builds and operates the ML platform, forecasting engines, and data processing services that deliver demand forecasting, inventory recommendations, and predictive insights to enterprise customers in retail, supply chain, and beyond. This role reports to the Director of Engineering for Predictive Intelligence and serves as the senior technical leader across the predictive intelligence pillar.

Your Impact

  • Own the overall architecture and technical strategy for Anaplan’s predictive intelligence services across multiple verticalised solutions.
  • Drive a unified architectural approach across disparate intelligence services, reducing duplication and establishing shared platform primitives for forecasting, model serving, and data processing.
  • Provide hands-on design and implementation leadership for major features and platform initiatives, including writing and reviewing critical-path code where the work demands it.
  • Define and oversee the MLOps strategy spanning model training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management on Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • Establish and evangelize engineering best practices across services, including standards for scalability, fault tolerance, observability, and operational excellence.
  • Mentor senior engineers and partner closely with data scientists to elevate technical quality and shorten the path from research to production.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Platform leadership to shape the multi-quarter technical roadmap and influence cross-organisation decisions on predictive intelligence.
  • Represent the AI engineering organisation in technical conversations and architectural reviews with outside teams.

Your Qualifications

  • Strong experience working within Software Engineering, Principal or Architect-level role owning systems at scale.
  • Deep expertise in Python and in designing and operating high-availability, production ML services.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data and analytics platforms built on technologies such as Snowflake, Iceberg, Trino, and Postgres.
  • Strong production experience with Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with working familiarity across multi-cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with MLOps tooling and patterns, including model registries, experiment tracking, and CI/CD for.
  • Proven ability to lead architectural strategy across multiple teams and services, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex technical decisions into clear narratives for engineers, data scientists, product partners, and executives.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience operating forecasting models in production, including gradient-boosted methods, neural networks, and constraint-based optimization solvers.
  • Domain background in retail, supply chain, demand planning, or financial planning.
  • Experience leading post-acquisition platform integration or cross-organisation architectural alignment across previously independent products.
  • Open-source contributions to ML infrastructure, data processing, or related ecosystems.
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet.   • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

  • Comfortable with python

  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

  • Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

Commodity Trading Analytics Internship Program

Six-Month Internship: 15 June – 16 December 2027
London (full-time, on site)

Engelhart’s Internship Program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with London-based front office teams working at the intersection of commodities markets, data, analytics and trading. Interns will contribute to practical, data-led projects that support commercial decision-making, forecasting and market analysis across macro commodities, power and related markets. To be eligible for consideration, applicants must have the right to work in the UK and be available to commence their six-month internship on site from 15 June 2027.

The internship opportunities covered by this advert are as follows:

  • Macro Commodities Analytics Intern, London
  • Structured UK Power Analytics Intern, London
  • Systematic Quantatitive Development Intern, London

Applicants may indicate areas of particular interest during the process, but final role allocation will be based on business need, candidate profile and overall fit. The London opportunities are expected to include a quantitative developer profile for Macro Commodities and Systematic Trading, and a broad market analytics profile for the Structured UK Power Desk.

What You Can Expect

  • Hands-on experience on a commodities trading desk, working on analytical projects with real commercial relevance.
  • Exposure to how data, analytics, forecasting and modelling support trading and commercial decisions across broader macro commodities or specifically UK power markets.
  • Close learning and mentorship from experienced front office professionals, including direct exposure to desk leadership.
  • A structured six-month internship within a global commodities business, combining cohort-based learning with deep desk integration.

Example Project Areas

Depending on the internship opportunity, projects may include analysing market and alternative datasets, refining forecasts, developing Python-based models or tools, applying machine learning techniques, supporting financial modelling, building predictive models or optimisation workflows for systematic trading, and producing insights that help inform front office trading and commercial decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with a front office team on data-led projects within macro commodities, systematic trading, or structured UK power.
  • Analyse market, trading and alternative datasets to identify insights that support forecasting, valuation and commercial decision-making.
  • Develop, test or improve analytical tools, models, dashboards or workflows using Python and other relevant tools.
  • Support forecasting, financial modelling, machine learning or quantitative analysis activities, depending on desk requirements.
  • Conduct market research and present findings clearly to technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Contribute to day-to-day desk activity, building practical understanding of how analytics supports trading and portfolio decisions.

About You

Across our 2027 internship program, we are looking for motivated, intellectually curious individuals who are keen to apply strong analytical and technical skills to real business challenges in commodities, power and financial markets. You should be comfortable working with data, learning quickly, and collaborating closely with front office teams in a fast-paced trading environment.

The following experiences and skills are essential for application:

  • Strong academic background in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, Finance or a related STEM field.
  • Strong Python skills, with the ability to analyse, manipulate and interpret complex data sets.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.
  • Evidence of applying data analysis, coding or quantitative methods to a practical problem, gained through academic projects, internships, research, personal projects or other relevant experience.
  • Demonstrable interest in commodities, power or financial markets, including an ability to discuss relevant market developments, gained through academic study, projects, internships, research or personal interest.
  • Business-level English proficiency.
  • Right to work in the UK for the full duration of the internship.
  • Effective communication skills and a collaborative mindset, with the confidence to work closely with commercial and technical stakeholders.
  • Intellectual curiosity, with the motivation to understand how market fundamentals, data and commercial decisions interact.

The following would be advantageous:

  • Experience with SQL, machine learning, financial modelling, advanced Excel, or working with alternative datasets.
  • Exposure to forecasting models, valuation, optimisation, time-series analysis or large market datasets.

We believe in inclusivity and are therefore dedicated to ensuring all employees – across gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, life experience, background and more – feel welcome and included in the company. We promote diversity because we believe it is essential to our ability to think holistically.

description: About Odin Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why We're Hiring We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely. You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like. This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standard we expect from candidates. And because you'll often be the first person someone meets from Odin, you'll need to give exceptional people a reason to care about a company many of them haven't heard of yet. Employer brand is a core part of the role, not something you get to once hiring goes quiet. You'll help build the content, events and community engine that puts Odin in front of the best operators in tech before they're looking for their next job - and makes hiring easier over time. Responsibilities Run hiring end to end across senior and business-critical roles, from role scoping through to start date. Own pipeline. The people we most want to hire often aren't applying, so outbound, market mapping, network building and getting others involved in referrals are a core part of the week. Run hiring kick-offs that create real clarity around what the role is, what great looks like, and how we're going to assess it. Design interview processes that test reasoning, behaviours and capability rather than rehearsed answers, using challenges, scorecards and structured assessments where appropriate. Own candidate communication end to end, with the same level of care whether someone is progressing or not. Keep employer brand top of mind and be hands-on in shaping it. Whether through content, events or community, you'll find ways to put Odin in front of the right people before they're looking for a job. Use AI as part of how you operate across sourcing, research, screening, candidate experience, operations and employer branding. Use hiring data to change decisions, prioritise roles and coach managers — not simply to report on the funnel. Continuously improve how we use Ashby, our hiring documentation and the quality of our interviews. Give clear, well-reasoned hiring recommendations with limited oversight, including when your view isn't what a hiring manager wants to hear. Who You Are An experienced recruiter with an unusually high bar for quality and strong judgement across functions. You notice patterns, inconsistencies and signals others can miss, and assess reasoning, behaviours, capability and values rather than relying on experience on paper. Brilliant at asking questions and getting underneath people's reasoning. You surface the questions others are thinking but haven't said out loud, interrogate incomplete briefs, and keep digging until there's real clarity. Comfortable bringing an original point of view rather than simply playing back what's already been said. You'll challenge founders and hiring managers when needed, and do it constructively. Deeply care about candidate experience, even when things are moving quickly, and hold the same bar whether someone is progressing or not. Operationally tight: you spot blockers early, keep processes moving and improve the system while using it. You've used AI in a meaningful way to improve how you hire and can give clear examples of what changed as a result. Bonus if you have Experience as a first or early Talent hire, where you've had to build structure from scratch. Experience building employer brand or talent marketing that materially changed who engaged with or applied to a company. Experience using hiring funnel or market data to influence decisions, prioritise roles or coach hiring managers. This role is probably not for you if... You need a lot of structure before you can make progress. There's plenty here still to build, and you'll need to be comfortable creating clarity rather than waiting for it. You avoid making decisions when the context is incomplete. We need someone who can gather the right information, form a view and make high-quality calls without escalating every grey area. You find it difficult to challenge senior stakeholders. You'll need to push back constructively, challenge assumptions and drive clarity with people across the business. You don't enjoy outbound. Proactive pipeline building is a significant part of this role; relying predominantly on inbound won't work here. You tend to take briefs at face value. We want someone who reads between the lines, asks what's missing and brings their own point of view rather than simply executing what they're given. Bottom line This isn't about whether you've done 360 hiring before - it's about how you approach it. We're not looking for someone to simply execute a hiring process. We're looking for a Talent partner who thinks deeply about the role hiring plays in the business, asks excellent questions, brings their own judgement and isn't afraid to challenge when needed. You'll often be the first person a candidate meets, and you'll have a meaningful influence on how our managers think about hiring. You're not just moving people through a process. You're helping us decide what great looks like, finding those people, shaping their experience of Odin and raising the quality of how we hire as we grow. Salary £70,000–£80,000 + equity options Working at Odin We're a London-based team, and this is a role where working closely with the founders and wider team in person makes a real difference. We therefore expect this person to be in our London office at least three days per week. description: Job description We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin. The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions. The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites. As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders. Your responsibilities Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work. Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code. Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance. Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure. Your profile Relevant Tech Skills Required: Python and shell scripting. Linux servers in production. Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker). Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent). Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling). Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design. A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context. Nice to have: S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph). Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools. Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM). Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information. Some experience deploying AI projects. Qualifications You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud). Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects. You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks. A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment. Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!). Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders. Good communication skills in English. Please indicate in your cover letter your earliest possible start date and your expected daily rate. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed. We encourage you to apply using the application form. We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique. description: UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART). Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. The Cultural Anchor: Own It We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership: "We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible. What You’ll Work On System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks. Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling. Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions. Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments. Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations. Ideal Candidate Profile: The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for. Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling. Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone. Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions. Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork. A Note on Our Search We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches. Why Join Source.dev? AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices. Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware. Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one. Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers. You do not need previous pharmacy experience or a pharmacy qualification for this role. What we are looking for is someone with strong people leadership experience who knows how to run a successful shift, manage competing priorities, support their team and maintain high standards in a busy operational environment. As Pharmacy Team Lead, you will be right at the heart of our day-to-day pharmacy operations. This is a hands-on role where no two days will be the same. You will help coordinate shifts, manage changing priorities, resolve operational challenges and provide clear, confident guidance to colleagues. You will act as a visible and approachable point of leadership on shift, ensuring workloads are managed effectively, standards are consistently maintained and any issues are identified and addressed quickly. You will also support the development of your colleagues through regular feedback, coaching and encouragement, helping them build their confidence, strengthen their skills and take pride in the service they provide. Working closely with the Pharmacy Manager and wider Pharmacy Operations team, you will help drive continuous improvement across the pharmacy. Whether it’s finding better ways of working, improving efficiency, strengthening communication or supporting the implementation of new processes, you will have the opportunity to contribute ideas and make a genuine difference to how we operate. This role would be perfect for someone who thrives in a busy environment, enjoys bringing people together and is ready to take greater ownership and responsibility. You will need to be organised, proactive and calm under pressure, with the confidence to make decisions, support colleagues and maintain excellent standards. You don’t need to be a pharmacy expert — you need to be a great leader. We will support you in developing your understanding of our pharmacy environment, processes and requirements. Previous experience leading, supervising or managing a team in a busy environment Experience managing day-to-day operations, workloads, priorities and staffing requirements Strong people management skills, with the ability to motivate, coach and develop colleagues The confidence to make decisions, resolve challenges and take ownership of issues through to completion Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep operations running smoothly during busy periods Excellent attention to detail and a consistent commitment to high standards Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships across different teams A supportive and approachable leadership style, with a genuine interest in helping others succeed Experience giving feedback and managing performance where required A calm, proactive and solutions-focused approach in a fast-paced and changing environment Confidence using computer-based systems, with the ability to learn new tools and processes quickly Flexibility to work across weekday and weekend shifts as part of the pharmacy rota A willingness to learn and develop your understanding of pharmacy operations, healthcare processes and regulatory requirements A patient-first mindset and a genuine passion for delivering an exceptional standard of service What we’re looking for We are particularly interested in people who have worked as a Team Leader, Assistant Manager, Supervisor, Operations Manager, Store Manager, Contact Centre Team Leader, Warehouse Team Leader or in another people-management position where they have been responsible for leading a team and keeping day-to-day operations running effectively. description: Wofür wir stehen: “We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.” Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit. Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact. Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Deine Aufgaben: Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht. AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht. SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt. Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat. Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht. Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt. Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst. Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages. Damit kannst Du punkten: Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen. Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. Das ist für uns keine Formalie: Wer den Projektalltag schon einmal von innen gesehen hat, steigt hier deutlich schneller ein. Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung. Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools. Excel oder Sheets solide, und keine Angst vor größeren Datenmengen. Erste Berührung mit SQL, GA4 oder Search Console ist ein Plus. Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss. Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch. Verfügbarkeit: Mindestens 6 Monate. Kürzer lohnt sich für dich nicht – die ersten Wochen gehen fürs Reinkommen drauf. Was wir von Dir benötigen: Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir: Deinen CV Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin Warum wir? Ein Praktikum ist bei uns kein Parkplatz. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das noch niemand fertig gelöst hat – mit echten Kundendaten, in einem Team, das dich fragt, was du gesehen hast. Ein Thema mit Zukunft: AI Search ist keine Nische, die wieder verschwindet. Was du hier lernst, ist in zwei Jahren ein gesuchtes Profil und du kannst dann belegen, dass du von Anfang an dabei warst. Echte Betreuung: Feste Ansprechperson, wöchentlicher Jour fixe, Zwischen- und Abschlussfeedback. Kein „Melde dich, wenn du was brauchst“. Übernahmeperspektive, ehrlich benannt: Wir bauen dieses Feld auf und suchen parallel auf Senior-Level. Wenn es passt, ist der Weg über Junior in eine der beiden Rollen realistisch – wir versprechen es nicht, aber wir meinen es. Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor. Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität – Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich, auch als Praktikant:in. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir bekommen Studium und Praktikum zusammen. Prüfungszeiten planen wir ein, wenn du sie früh sagst. Mobility & Events: Öffi-Ticket-Zuschuss, Teamevents und die Chance, auf Fachkonferenzen mitzufahren. Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks. Diese Position ist ein Praktikum im Consulting Cluster von TOWA. Die Vergütung beträgt 1.800 EUR brutto pro Monat auf Vollzeitbasis. Bei einem Teilzeit-Modell wird der Betrag aliquot angepasst. Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern. description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About the Role 

We're seeking a versatile Principal Data scientist who can work across the full stack of Anaplan AI applications, from model integration and prompt engineering to building intuitive user interfaces. In this role, you will have a direct impact on our industry-leading platform by architecting and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions that drive intelligent, automated, and forward-looking decision-making for our global customers. You will bridge the gap between traditional predictive algorithms and modern generative systems.

Your Impact

  • Advanced Modeling & Predictive Analytics: Lead the research, design, and implementation of advanced Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Timeseries Forecasting models to solve complex enterprise business and planning challenges.
  • Generative AI Architecture: Architect GenAI solutions, focusing on fine-tuning proprietary and open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) via Transformer architectures for specialised enterprise data tasks.
  • Next-Gen Interfaces: Design and integrate Conversational AI and autonomous Agentic AI workflows, creating intuitive experiences that can independently execute complex planning tasks.
  • Production & Scale: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Design teams to transition AI models from early prototypes into robust, highly scalable production systems.
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as a core subject matter expert, mentoring cross-functional teams and driving a culture of technical excellence, rigorous testing, and continuous learning.

Your Skills

  • Extensive professional engineering experience across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related domains.
  • Deep technical understanding of Transformer architectures, prompt engineering, and conversational AI patterns, alongside practical experience with autonomous agent frameworks.
  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF) specifically for domain-specific enterprise applications.
  • Taken responsibility of models from concept to production, utilising strong MLOps and LLMOps practices to ensure scalable, reliable, and monitorable deployments.
  • High proficiency in Python and modern software development practices, including rigorous testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong hands-on experience in traditional Machine Learning and deep learning techniques, specifically including Timeseries Forecasting algorithms.

Desirable

  • Background in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience working with scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and MLOps tools for model training, monitoring, and deployment.
  • Background in forecasting, planning, or analytics applications
  • Familiarity with Anaplan or similar enterprise planning platforms
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks for AI features
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or research publications

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Neobank. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Starts from user problems, not feature lists. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: As Programme Manager, you'll be the person who turns strategic direction into structured, trackable, real-world delivery. You won't manage the teams — but you'll shape how they work, what they work on, and whether the initiatives your Head of Operations is driving actually stick. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who is equally at home building a project plan, designing a process, and presenting to a VP. You'll sit across the whole of Trade Lifecycle, partnering closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, and CRM to make sure the right things get built, rolled out, and embedded — not just kicked off. Forget long lists, here's what you'll actually spend your time on: Strategic programme management: own the delivery of Trade Lifecycle's most critical initiatives end to end — from scoping and planning through to execution and review Tooling and systems rollout: lead the planning and delivery of tooling changes across Retention, Credit Control, and Trade Support — working closely with stakeholders to define requirements, manage timelines, and make sure the teams are set up to use new systems effectively. Process design and standardisation: identify where processes are inconsistent, undocumented, or breaking down under scale — and fix them. Change management and embedding: new initiatives have a habit of not sticking. You'll own the change management layer — stakeholder communication, rollout sequencing, training and adoption tracking Cross-functional alignment: act as the senior point of coordination between Trade Lifecycle and Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, and CRM. Insight and performance tracking: build and maintain the reporting infrastructure that shows whether strategic initiatives are working. Own the KPI framework for transformation delivery It's not about ticking every box. It's about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You'll do well here if you bring: Depth of experience in a programme, operations, or strategy delivery role — ideally in a high-growth tech or marketplace business. Proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives from design through to measurable outcome — not just managing the plan, but owning the result. Strong project management instincts — you can hold multiple workstreams simultaneously, spot dependencies before they become blockers, and keep senior stakeholders clearly informed without overwhelming them. Experience leading tooling or systems rollouts in an operational environment — you understand the change management challenge, not just the technical one. Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Jira, Asana, Monday, or equivalent) and reporting tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, or Sheets/Excel at an advanced level). We believe great work deserves great rewards. Here's just a taste: Competitive salary + annual bonus Employee Share Programme Health, well-being and learning support Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme and Cycle Scheme Birthday/Special day leave Buy & sell holiday scheme 1 week's paid charity leave and much more! How we'll get to know each other: Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners 1st stage: interview with the hiring manager 2nd stage: interview with our Interim VP, Business Operations Final stage: panel interview including a short analysis case study If this sounds like the place where you can do your best work, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't tick every box. Register your interest on our Registration Form At the moment, this role isn’t open to visa sponsorship applications. About us We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business. We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in. description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling. What you'll do Build automated dataset quality evaluation and root-cause detection — model-assisted and LLM-as-judge screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output Hire, train, calibrate and manage a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists based in our India operation, held to inter-rater agreement and catch rate rather than volume audited Turn audit output into labelled ground truth that trains and validates the automated layer, and manage the ratio of automated to manual coverage deliberately over time Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships Build scoring systems that rank annotator and reviewer performance and feed routing, staffing and offboarding decisions Set the pass thresholds that certification gates on, so nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability Who we're looking for You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country Your instinct on a coverage problem is to automate it — you reach for a model, a heuristic or a better sampling design before you reach for more auditors Statistically literate in a practical way: sampling design, agreement statistics, and the judgement to spot a metric being optimised against rather than met You can hold a calibrated standard across a distributed team you don't sit with — you know that ten uncalibrated auditors produce ten standards A strong writer. Much of this job is producing rubrics a distributed workforce can follow without you in the room You hold a standard under commercial pressure, and you bring the evidence that makes it stick with a delivery team or a client Systems thinker: as interested in why a failure recurs across projects as in this project's defect rate Experience requirements 4+ years owning both technical and operational outcomes in a data, AI or service delivery environment where quality was measured rather than asserted Hands-on Python and SQL. You build the analysis and the tooling rather than specify it for someone else Practical experience applying models to a quality or evaluation problem — LLM-as-judge, model-assisted QA, automated evaluation, anomaly detection or classifier-based screening Sampling methodology and agreement statistics (Cohen's and Fleiss' kappa, F1 against ground truth) applied to real production data Experience hiring, training and managing a team, ideally an audit, review or QA team, and ideally distributed Track record of building a quality framework or function, including the reporting leadership and customers run on Bonus: direct experience of annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows, and of what frontier AI labs accept as evidence of quality Bonus: a STEM degree, or a background in data science or research engineering Bonus: multilingual delivery and linguistic quality assessment Why Encord Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays Annual learning & development budget Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe Company lunches twice a week Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description:
C++/Kotlin Software Developer (RustRover Debugger)

You care deeply about how developer tools are built, especially when it comes to the intricacies of debugging. You enjoy solving complex, low-level problems and want to make the Rust ecosystem better for everyone.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Rust is growing fast. To give the community a dedicated, smart IDE, we released RustRover, a core part of which is the debugger. Right now, it sets a high bar, but there's plenty of room to push it further – both by building new features and by untangling tricky configurations.

As a Software Developer on the RustRover team, you’ll take ownership of the RustRover debugger's state, driving its development across two interconnected parts: the OS-specific C++ debugger (LLDB or GDB) and the IntelliJ-based Java/Kotlin client. You’ll work independently but collaborate closely with our flat, cross-functional team of developers, QA specialists, and support engineers to make debugging Rust applications smoother and more reliable.

Day to day, you will:

  • Improve and expand the RustRover debugger across its C++ backend and Java/Kotlin frontend.
  • Implement new IDE run/debug configurations, such as remote development support.
  • Enhance Rust expression evaluation capabilities.
  • Investigate and fix OS-specific SIGSEGV errors in C++ code from LLDB.
  • Design clear, maintainable code and ensure the algorithms behind it are sound.

What you’ll bring

  • A genuine interest in making development and debugging more convenient.
  • Comfort taking ownership of complex problems and figuring things out.
  • An appreciation for clean, readable, and maintainable code.
  • A proactive approach to communication and the ability to work independently.
  • Openness to diverse opinions and the ability to explain your reasoning clearly.
  • A drive to master new approaches, technologies, and paradigms.

What you’ll need

  • Strong proficiency in C++ programming.
  • A solid understanding of system programming and multi-process communication.
  • A strong grasp of software development processes and life cycles.
  • Basic knowledge of Java or Kotlin, or a readiness to learn quickly.
  • Familiarity with compiler development, LLVM/LLDB, or low-level debugging on various OS platforms is a strong plus.
  • Experience with other languages like Rust, Clojure, Python, Ruby, or Haskell is also a plus.

What success looks like

Success in this role means you're independently driving improvements in the RustRover debugger, bridging the gap between the C++ backend and the Kotlin/Java client. You are actively solving complex configuration issues, introducing reliable new features, and leaving the codebase cleaner than you found it. Ultimately, you are earning the trust of the Rust community by making their debugging experience significantly smoother.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
  • Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
  • Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world’s largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You’ll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, develop and improve recommendation, ranking and retrieval models that surface relevant restaurants, dishes, items and content to customers.
  • Own applied ML problems end to end: frame the problem, analyze data, develop models, define offline evaluation, run experiments and monitor production performance.
  • Develop methods that balance relevance with product and customer needs, such as diversity, availability, business constraints and changing user intent.
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, Product Managers and Analysts to turn scientific insights into reliable customer-facing products.
  • Evaluate and apply state-of-the-art ML methods where they meaningfully improve recommendation quality, robustness or efficiency.
  • Contribute to a high bar for applied-science practice through technical reviews, knowledge sharing and thoughtful experimentation.

Our humble expectations

  • You have substantial hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world problems and a track record of bringing models from development into production; a PhD with relevant applied research experience is equally welcome.
  • You have experience with recommendation systems, ranking, retrieval, personalisation, or closely related ML problems.
  • You can independently turn an ambiguous customer or product problem into a well-scoped ML approach, make sound trade-offs and drive it to a measurable outcome.
  • You are proficient in Python and experienced with modern ML frameworks and large-scale data processing.
  • You understand how to evaluate ML systems rigorously, including offline metrics, experiment design and interpreting online results.
  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross-functional partners.

What we offer

You will work on recommendation problems with direct, measurable impact on how customers discover relevant content. You’ll collaborate with experienced scientists and engineers across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt, learning from multiple recommendation systems while helping shape the next generation of the experience.

Together with your lead, you will have the opportunity to create a personalised development plan that builds on your strengths and develops new capabilities.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
